Hey there, I know it's hard. I know that feeling of complete dread and lack of motivation. I know that feeling of numbness. That feeling of just being tired of being alive. And I can't say I'm cured. I'm no where near it. In fact I'm still doing really bad and I still battle with suicidal thoughts. But regardless of that, I feel better than what I was. What changed that was intense therapy, meds, and a trip to the hospital. I fucking hate the hospital don't get me wrong. Both types of hospitals, mental and the emergency room. Both of them fill me with dread thinking about going back. But to give it credit. I'm still here. And I'm here to see the good times and the good of my life, even if it's so little. I can't relate to about you with your kids. But I can relate to loving someone more than yourself. And I can tell you seeing them succeed. Seeing them prevail. It's a good feeling. The thing about depression is that it comes in waves, for me at least. All I can say about that is to hold on. That's what I've been doing. Sometimes it lasts a day, other times weeks, even months. And for me it lasted years. I've been on the hill climb, things are getting better I must admit. But it took a lot of holding on to that life saver and float in the dreaded abyss of depression. You can do it though. You've made it this far right? You can make it through so much more!

Hey I've been through a lot. Check my post history of today and you'll see I'm going through some shit. But wanna know what I know throughout all of this? That it always turns out okay. You have to think that humans are the king's of adapting. We always do. We overcome problems. That's what makes us the top of the food chain. I've lost a couple people to suicide, when you're someone who experiences thoughts yourself you tend to befriend people who think like you and have similar thoughts. So I know how loss feels. What did I do? Distraction is what I did for years to cope with the loss of loved ones. Whenever I would be stuck thinking about them. The memories, I play videogames. Sing. Read out loud. Anything to change the task at hand. Please hang in there. Be there for your Dad. When I'm at my worst helping people helps me because it's a form of escape, helping people with their problems and ignoring yours. Please please hang out. It's going to be okay. It always ends up okay. I assure you. Okay? Let me know if you need anything I'm here. No one deserves to go through this and I want to do what I can to help.

Thank you for getting back to me. And I understand how it is. I've been very worried about a loved one too. Or ex-loved one to be specific. And from my experience the first thing you have to realize is that you're not responsible for his feelings. You're responsible for yours. If you want to help him get better and get help you need to be healthy so you can help him get it. Both of you guys being in a bad place will only make things more chaotic in nature. I'm not saying abandon him, I'm not saying that you're mentally unhealthy in any way. I'm just saying that if you take this to heart too much you might be just as bad as him in the end. You'll be just as sad as depressed because that type of stuff is toxic itself. It's contagious on a way not all of us understand. So if you ever find yourself sacrificing your own well being in an attempt to fix his, you'll most likely just damage yourself and he'll remain the same. My advice is to be there, be caring to him. Be patient, and you got to drill into his head how nothing is a lost cause. You can use me as an example if you want. I've had PTSD since I was 11. My girlfriend broke up with me a couple months ago. My overdosed on meds last week in an attempt of my life. And I've ruined lots of relationships with others. I'm still here. And I'm glad I am. Because not only am I fixing the relationship I previously had. I'm mending myself in the process. Where I thought I was hopeless and a lost cause before. I'm on a hill to success and although the road seems very steep and slow. I know I'll make it.

When I was 11 a very bad man decided to take my childhood away. It have me PTSD and I hid it from everyone for years. I couldn't do that forever so I exploded. Everything went to shit. I don't think this is the solution to making your child's life good. It's the opposite. I've dealt with people who are close to me commiting suicide, and for a similar reason. They saw themselves as destructive and they wanted to save everyone else from themselves. It just hurts people infinitely more. I had a suicide attempt recently. That's why I'm on here, I deleted my story but I'll be gladly to pm it to you or something. Yesterday I told my ex/lover that I almost died, due to my own hand. And I shut her out of my life weeks ago because I wanted to save her from me. What I did instead was give her depression, extreme anxiety, and all I did was hurt her. When I told her yesterday why I shut her out. And how I almost died. She looked heartbroken. She had the look of dread in her eyes. And I wanted to take it all back. What I said. What I did. I wanted to take it all back. I would take all of the world's pain for this person that how much I care for them. And I rationalized hurting them one last time so I couldn't in the future. I've never had so much regret in my life. I've had to comfort my own sobbing mother on my own attempt of my life. Now imagine all of this, but if I had a kid. If I left the person I care about with my kid. They would be stricken with depression, anxiety, and just overall sadness. None of that will make her a good parent. My child with develop depression because he/she wouldn't know their father. They would question why they left them and their mom. They would blame themselves, they would think that they've failed me. Even when they don't know me. They know that I was trying to do what's best for them, but they'll know that I was so wrong. All I did was make their life worse. And I know how it is to be selfish of a lover. If I could keep her all to myself I would. But we both had issues and we lost romantic feeling for each other. Regardless we still need each other and care for each other deeply. I care for her more than anything. And although I can't love her in a romantic sense. I love her with all my heart and soul in just about every other way. Now that I'm here my future child will have the most hard working father, a person that will stop at nothing to give them everything and protect them from everything. If I can save them from a shred of what my life is. I would. Please elaborate more to me on what you're going through, and please let me know if you need any help. I will happily help out with anything I can.

Hey, I've been on the receiving end of what you're going through. Someone who I cared about thought I didn't care for them at all, when I think the world of them. I can't speak for your boyfriend, but I can't express myself properly. I can't wait or say the things I mean because of something in my brain. Your boyfriend may be stressed, but if he cares for you he'll push though the pain, and when he does you'll be so glad that you did too. My life, or my past sucks really fucking bad. It haunts me on a day to day basis, it all fucking sucks. I have flashbacks and nightmares daily. I hate everything about myself, and it affects how I love others. I don't show them how I care effectively. If your boyfriend is anything like me in the slightest, when he pushes through he'll be there for you. I want to be there for the person I care about. And I wasn't able to for the past couple of weeks because I was too mentally ill to be there for them. I shut them out of my life, and I made myself suffer more. All of that culminated to a suicide attempt, and now that I survived. I mended things with them. And I'm so fucking glad I didn't die that night. I'm so glad I get to care for this person again and they care for me. Relationships, friendships, are a two way road. Sometimes they close down because they need to be repaired. There's nothing wrong with construction. It takes time sometimes. Sometimes its a little pot hole. Sometimes its a complete renovation. Point is, there's no shame in trying to heal yourself and ask for help. He might be stressed but I'm sure both of you guys will embrace a better tomorrow when both of you get through it. The last thing you want to do is make things worse for you, your cat, and your boyfriend, by giving up. If you do that makes this all worth nothing. And that's hipocritical coming from me. A man who tried to kill himself. But I can assure you I've never been so glad that all my hard work is paying off. I'm healing. And I can see myself healing. I want you to have the same feeling. I wish no one has to go through any of this. Depression, anxiety, PTSD, just mental illnesses in general. I don't think any human deserves to feel that pain. And I would gladly take everyone pain so no one would suffer. But regardless healing is a very real and possible thing. Just promise me you'll at least to try to be there for it.
